# Written by a harness outside this repository with ICU4C 78.3's spoof checker (`icu/security.c`).
# `skeleton`: uspoof_getSkeleton of each code point of `inputs` (those ICU's Unicode version assigns whose
# NFD holds no code point whose confusables.txt line changed since), as UTF-8 each followed by 0xff.
# The pairs: `count` of them from `seed` by splitmix64, 1 to 8 positions of `alphabet`'s groups (members
# joined by /): a length, then each position's group, the first string's member and the second's, modulo.
# `logical`, `ltr`, `rtl`: the first string's skeletons; `confusable`: a byte, 0 or single-, mixed-,
# whole-script 1-3; `restriction`: a byte, ASCII-only 0 to unrestricted 5 (profile: ICU's recommended and
# inclusion sets); `checks`: a byte, 1 restricted, 2 mixed numbers, 4 repeated mark, 8 hidden overlay.
# Each the SHA-256 of all of them in order. src/testing/security_test.zig reaches the same.
